content: आसंसार, -संसृति {%a.%} Liable to progress or alteration. .{@-रम्, -ति@} {%ind.%} .²1 Till the end of the world or worldly existence; <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²2 Within the limits or range of worldly existence, throughout the sphere of worldly life; आसंसारं त्रिभुवनमिदं चिन्वताम् तात तादृक् <ls>Bh. 3. 46</ls>; आसंसृतेरस्मि जगत्सु जातः <ls>Ki. 3. 6</ls> (<ls>Malli.</ls> यावत्संसारम्).
